properties.sql:
create table AUM_TMP01
as
select    
    TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    DETAIL as PROD,
    TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    LST_MTN_DT AS YYYYMMDD,
    存款AUM AMT
from AUM_005_007_008_009  --存款AUM 總量、台幣存款AUM總量、結構型
where DETAIL is not null
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012  --【銀行】保險_原始投資金額
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    trustprd PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    CurrentTWDValue as AMT
from AUM_013_015_015_016_017_018
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '海外債券(自營)' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
from  AUM_019 --19.銀行_外國債券(自營平台)_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_020 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_021 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量--【銀行】股票及金錢信託_市值
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '信託保管' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_022  --銀行_信託保管_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    nm  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_023_024--證券_複委託債券_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '基金'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_025  ----25.證券_基金_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '外國股票'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_026  --26.證券_外國股票_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_027   --27.證券_台股_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_028   ----28.股票設質
;

create table AUM_BASE
as 
select a.* 
from 
    (select *
    from AUM_TMP01 
    where typ='存款'　
    ) a 
left join pb_cust_2AO b
on substr(a.yyyymmdd,1,6)=b.yyyymm　and a.cust_id=b.cust_id
where b.cust_id is null 
union 
select *
from AUM_TMP01 
where typ='投資'
;

create table INCOME_053_TMP02
as
select 'PM' AP ,idno as cust_id,
        CASE WHEN t.CLRDATE >= l.LAST2_WD 
            THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(t.CLRDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1),'YYYYMM') ||'01'
            ELSE SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6)  ||'01'
       END as yyyymmdd,
       sum((CFEE-ABFEE)*FXRATE) as amt
from DSPBM.PB_STOCKTRADM_PM_SEC@anadbp01_dwdbp01 t
LEFT JOIN T_LAST_TWO_WORKDAYS l ON SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6) = l.YM
where yyyymmdd = (select max(yyyymmdd) from DSPBM.PB_STOCKTRADM_PM_SEC@anadbp01_dwdbp01)
group by idno,CASE WHEN t.CLRDATE >= l.LAST2_WD 
            THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(t.CLRDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1),'YYYYMM') ||'01'
            ELSE SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6)  ||'01'
       END
union
select  'AM' AP ,idno as cust_id,
        CASE WHEN t.CLRDATE >= l.LAST2_WD 
            THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(t.CLRDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1),'YYYYMM') ||'01'
            ELSE SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6)  ||'01'
         END as yyyymmdd,
        sum((CFEE-ABFEE)*FXRATE) as amt
from DSPBM.PB_STOCKTRADM_AM_SEC_M@anadbp01_dwdbp01 t
LEFT JOIN T_LAST_TWO_WORKDAYS l ON SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6) = l.YM
where yyyymmdd =(select max(yyyymmdd) from DSPBM.PB_STOCKTRADM_AM_SEC@anadbp01_dwdbp01)
group by idno,CASE WHEN t.CLRDATE >= l.LAST2_WD 
            THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(t.CLRDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1),'YYYYMM') ||'01'
            ELSE SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6)  ||'01'
         END;

create table INCOME_053_TMP02
as
select 'PM' AP ,idno as cust_id,
        CASE WHEN t.CLRDATE >= l.LAST2_WD 
            THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(t.CLRDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1),'YYYYMM') ||'01'
            ELSE SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6)  ||'01'
       END as yyyymmdd,
       sum((CFEE-ABFEE)*FXRATE) as amt

LEFT JOIN T_LAST_TWO_WORKDAYS l ON SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6) = l.YM

            ELSE SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6)  ||'01'
       END

        CASE WHEN t.CLRDATE >= l.LAST2_WD

            ELSE SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6)  ||'01'
         END as yyyymmdd,
        sum((CFEE-ABFEE)*FXRATE) as amt
from DSPBM.PB_STOCKTRADM_AM_SEC_M@anadbp01_dwdbp01 t

where yyyymmdd =(select max(yyyymmdd) from DSPBM.PB_STOCKTRADM_AM_SEC@anadbp01_dwdbp01)
group by idno,CASE WHEN t.CLRDATE >= l.LAST2_WD

         END;

Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FH_TYP as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_037  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_038  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量 --TMU損益
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_039   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_040   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_041
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境外' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_042  --【銀行】境外結構型商品手收 總量*/
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_043   --銀行 FX(WBS) 手收

select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE,

on substr(a.yyyymmdd,1,6)=b.yyyymm　and a.cust_id=b.cust_id

union 
select *
from AUM_TMP01 
where typ='投資'
;

create table INCOME_053_TMP01
as
select 'PM' AP ,idno as cust_id,
        CASE WHEN t.CLRDATE >= l.LAST2_WD 
            THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(t.CLRDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1),'YYYYMM') ||'01'
            ELSE SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6)  ||'01'
       END as yyyymmdd,
       sum((CFEE-ABFEE)*FXRATE) as amt
from DSPBM.PB_STOCKTRADM_PM_SEC_M@anadbp01_dwdbp01 t
LEFT JOIN T_LAST_TWO_WORKDAYS l ON SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6) = l.YM
group by idno,CASE WHEN t.CLRDATE >= l.LAST2_WD 
            THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(t.CLRDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1),'YYYYMM') ||'01'
            ELSE SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6)  ||'01'
       END

create table AUM_023_024_TMP0
as 
select idno as cust_id,prcs_dt as yyyymmdd,nm,sum(NETQTY/100 *CPRICE * exch_rt) AMT
from 
      (select a.*,
              case when  bond like 'TSSN%' then '複委託結構型商品'
              else '複委託債券' end as NM
      from  DSPBM.PB_BONDPOS_SEC_M@anadbp01_dwdbp01 a ) a
left join 
     ( select A.*
     from dsdep.fn_exch_rt@anadbp01_dwdbp01 a
     inner join 
     ( 
         select substr(prcs_dt,1,6) yyyyymm,max(prcs_dt) prcs_dt 
         from dsdep.fn_exch_rt@anadbp01_dwdbp01 
         group by substr(prcs_dt,1,6)
     ) b on a.prcs_dt=b.prcs_dt
     )b  on a.currency=b.curr_cd and a.yyyymm=substr(b.prcs_dt,1,6)
group by idno,prcs_dt,nm
;

as

     idno cust_id,clrdate,
      case 
           when bond  like 'TSSN%'  then   '結構型商品'
            else '債券' end as  FLG,   
      CASE WHEN t.CLRDATE >= l.LAST2_WD

            ELSE SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6)  ||'01'

            ELSE SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6)  ||'01'
       END;

create table INCOME_033_034_035_036
as 
select  to_char(to_date(feedate+19110000,'yyyymmdd') ,'yyyymmdd' ) as yyyymmdd --substr(FEEDATE,1,6)  -- FHID,IDNO as cust_id,      
        ,idno as cust_id       
        ,case 
              when FHID not in ('PS','CB','YB','SN') then '基金' 
              when TRIM(FHID) ='YB' then 'ETF'
              when FHID ='PS' then '海外股票'
              when FHID like 'TA%' or FHID  like 'TB%' or FHID  like 'TD%' or FHID  like 'TE%'  then '集合管理帳戶'
        end as   FH_TYP 
        ,baopcccode PCCODE
        ,sum(BrhRebateAmt) as AMT
from DSFND.PB_FUND_SPREAD_DAILY@anadbp01_dwdbp01 
where  (baopcccode like '2E%' or saopcccode like '2E%') and feedate>='011212'  --and feedate='011403' 
group by  
      to_char(to_date(feedate+19110000,'yyyymmdd') ,'yyyymmdd' )   --substr(FEEDATE,1,6),
      ,idno
      ,case 
              when FHID not in ('PS','CB','YB','SN') then '基金' 
              when TRIM(FHID) ='YB' then 'ETF'
              when FHID ='PS' then '海外股票'
              when FHID like 'TA%' or FHID  like 'TB%' or FHID  like 'TD%' or FHID  like 'TE%'  then '集合管理帳戶'
       end
       ,baopcccode;

              when FHID like 'TA%' or FHID  like 'TB%' or FHID  like 'TD%' or FHID  like 'TE%'  then '集合管理帳戶'
        end as   FH_TYP 
        ,baopcccode PCCODE
        ,sum(BrhRebateAmt) as AMT
from DSFND.PB_FUND_SPREAD_DAILY@anadbp01_dwdbp01 
where  (baopcccode like '2E%' or saopcccode like '2E%') and feedate>='011212'  --and feedate='011403' 
group by  
      to_char(to_date(feedate+19110000,'yyyymmdd') ,'yyyymmdd' )   --substr(FEEDATE,1,6),
      ,idno
      ,case 
              when FHID not in ('PS','CB','YB','SN') then '基金' 
              when TRIM(FHID) ='YB' then 'ETF'
              when FHID ='PS' then '海外股票'
              when FHID like 'TA%' or FHID  like 'TB%' or FHID  like 'TD%' or FHID  like 'TE%'  then '集合管理帳戶'
       end
       ,baopcccode;

drop table PB_CUST_005_TMP1;
CREATE TABLE PB_CUST_005_TMP1
AS
  SELECT EMP_NO, IDNO, SHT_NM,
         substr(
          sht_nm,
          instr(sht_nm,'業')+2,
          instr(sht_nm,'部') -instr(sht_nm,'業') -1
          )  as SHT_SUB_NM 
           , E.* ,C.YYYYMM,A.PRFT_CNTR_CD
    FROM (
        SELECT a.*,substr(lst_mtn_dt,1,6) yyyymm
        FROM DSORG.AO_INFO@anadbp01_dwdbp01 a
        WHERE AO_TYP != 'AO1P' and prft_cntr_cd not in ('2E4300','2E5000')  --排除個金或通路的AO1P
    ) A  --
    INNER JOIN (
        -- AC 部門列別
      SELECT * FROM DSORG.PRFT_CNTR_CD@anadbp01_dwdbp01
      WHERE BU ='私人銀行處'
    ) B ON A.PRFT_CNTR_CD = B.PRFT_CNTR_CD  --2212
    LEFT JOIN (
        -- 在職
        SELECT a.*,substr(lst_mtn_dt,1,6) YYYYMM
        FROM DSORG.HR_EMP@anadbp01_dwdbp01 a
        WHERE JOB_STATUS = '1'
    ) C ON A.EMP_NO = TRIM(C.EMP_ID) And a.yyyymm=c.yyyymm  --2212
    LEFT JOIN (
        -- 職稱
        SELECT * FROM DSORG.HR_JOB_TYP_CD@anadbp01_dwdbp01  --2212
        where pst_nm like '%CA%' or trim(pst_cd) in ('VP026','VP030')
    ) E ON C.COMP_SERIAL_NO = E.COMP_SERIAL_NO 
        AND C.PST_CD = E.PST_CD
;

drop table INCOME_TMP01;
Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FH_TYP as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_037  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_038  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量 --TMU損益
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_039   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_040   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_041
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境外' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_042  --【銀行】境外結構型商品手收 總量*/
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_043   --銀行 FX(WBS) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE, 
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_044  --銀行 FX(TMU) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '開狀' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_045  --【銀行】開狀手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_046  --規劃型信託(股票信託、金錢信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_047  --規劃型信託(員工持股信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_048  --私人銀行事業處業績檔(保管)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '黃金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_049 --銀行 黃金 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FLG,
      '',
      cust_id,

drop table INCOME_TMP01;
Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險

select

      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量

select

drop table INCOME_TMP01;
Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險

select

      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量

select

drop table INCOME_TMP01;
Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險

select

      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量

select

drop table INCOME_TMP01;

      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,

drop table INCOME_TMP01;
Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FH_TYP as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null

select

drop table INCOME_TMP01;
Create table INCOME_TMP01

select

      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT

drop table INCOME_TMP02;
Create table INCOME_TMP02
as 
select a.*,
       b.emp_no,
       b.prft_cntr_cd,
       b.sht_nm,
       case 
          when sht_nm like '%業務一部%' then 'TW一部'
          when sht_nm like '%業務二部%' then 'TW二部'
        end as SHT_EASY_NM,
      substr(
          sht_nm,
          instr(sht_nm,'業')+2,
          instr(sht_nm,'部') -instr(sht_nm,'業') -1
          )  as SHT_SUB_NM,

properties.sql:
drop table INCOME_051_054_TMP02;
create table INCOME_051_054_TMP02
as
select 
     idno cust_id,clrdate,
      case 
           when bond  like 'TSSN%'  then   '結構型商品'
            else '債券' end as  FLG,   
      CASE WHEN t.CLRDATE >= l.LAST2_WD 
            THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(t.CLRDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1),'YYYYMM') ||'01'
            ELSE SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6)  ||'01'
       END AS yyyymmdd,
     sum( CFEE * FXRATE)  as amt
 from DSPBM.PB_BONDTRADM_SEC@anadbp01_dwdbp01 t
 LEFT JOIN T_LAST_TWO_WORKDAYS l ON SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6) = l.YM 
 where yyyymmdd = (select max(yyyymmdd) from DSPBM.PB_BONDTRADM_SEC@anadbp01_dwdbp01)
 group by idno,
       case 
           when bond  like 'TSSN%'  then   '結構型商品'
            else '債券' end,clrdate, 
        CASE WHEN t.CLRDATE >= l.LAST2_WD 
            THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(t.CLRDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1),'YYYYMM') ||'01'
            ELSE SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6)  ||'01'
       END;

union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,

    CUST_ID,

    amt

union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,

    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,

from AUM_013_015_015_016_017_018

select

    '銀行'  COMP,

select

    amt

select

    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,

from AUM_023_024--證券_複委託債券_AUM總量
union 
select

    '證券'  COMP,
    '基金'  as PROD,

    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,

drop table AUM;
create table AUM
as
select    
    TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    DETAIL as PROD,
    TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    LST_MTN_DT AS YYYYMMDD,
    存款AUM AMT
from AUM_005_007_008_009  --存款AUM 總量、台幣存款AUM總量、結構型
where DETAIL is not null
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012  --【銀行】保險_原始投資金額
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    trustprd PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    CurrentTWDValue as AMT
from AUM_013_015_015_016_017_018
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '海外債券(自營)' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
from  AUM_019 --19.銀行_外國債券(自營平台)_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_020 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_021 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量--【銀行】股票及金錢信託_市值
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '信託保管' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_022  --銀行_信託保管_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    nm  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_023_024--證券_複委託債券_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '基金'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_025  ----25.證券_基金_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '外國股票'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_026  --26.證券_外國股票_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_027   --27.證券_台股_AUM總量

select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,

    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_028   ----28.股票設質
;

drop table INCOME_033_034_035_036;
create table INCOME_033_034_035_036
as 
select  to_char(to_date(feedate+19110000,'yyyymmdd') ,'yyyymmdd' ) as yyyymmdd --substr(FEEDATE,1,6)  -- FHID,IDNO as cust_id,      
        ,idno as cust_id       
        ,case 
              when FHID not in ('PS','CB','YB','SN') then '基金' 
              when TRIM(FHID) ='YB' then 'ETF'
              when FHID ='PS' then '海外股票'
              when FHID like 'TA%' or FHID  like 'TB%' or FHID  like 'TD%' or FHID  like 'TE%'  then '集合管理帳戶'
        end as   FH_TYP 
        ,baopcccode PCCODE
        ,sum(BrhRebateAmt) as AMT
from DSFND.PB_FUND_SPREAD_DAILY@anadbp01_dwdbp01 
where  (baopcccode like '2E%' or saopcccode like '2E%') and feedate>='011212'  --and feedate='011403' 
group by  
      to_char(to_date(feedate+19110000,'yyyymmdd') ,'yyyymmdd' )   --substr(FEEDATE,1,6),
      ,idno
      ,case 
              when FHID not in ('PS','CB','YB','SN') then '基金' 
              when TRIM(FHID) ='YB' then 'ETF'
              when FHID ='PS' then '海外股票'
              when FHID like 'TA%' or FHID  like 'TB%' or FHID  like 'TD%' or FHID  like 'TE%'  then '集合管理帳戶'
       end
       ,baopcccode;

drop table PB_CUST_005_TMP1;
CREATE TABLE PB_CUST_005_TMP1
AS
  SELECT EMP_NO, IDNO, SHT_NM,
         substr(
          sht_nm,
          instr(sht_nm,'業')+2,
          instr(sht_nm,'部') -instr(sht_nm,'業') -1
          )  as SHT_SUB_NM 
           , E.* ,C.YYYYMM,A.PRFT_CNTR_CD
    FROM (
        SELECT a.*,substr(lst_mtn_dt,1,6) yyyymm
        FROM DSORG.AO_INFO@anadbp01_dwdbp01 a
        WHERE AO_TYP != 'AO1P' and prft_cntr_cd not in ('2E4300','2E5000')  --排除個金或通路的AO1P
    ) A  --
    INNER JOIN (
        -- AC 部門列別
      SELECT * FROM DSORG.PRFT_CNTR_CD@anadbp01_dwdbp01
      WHERE BU ='私人銀行處'
    ) B ON A.PRFT_CNTR_CD = B.PRFT_CNTR_CD  --2212
    LEFT JOIN (
        -- 在職
        SELECT a.*,substr(lst_mtn_dt,1,6) YYYYMM
        FROM DSORG.HR_EMP@anadbp01_dwdbp01 a
        WHERE JOB_STATUS = '1'
    ) C ON A.EMP_NO = TRIM(C.EMP_ID) And a.yyyymm=c.yyyymm  --2212
    LEFT JOIN (
        -- 職稱
        SELECT * FROM DSORG.HR_JOB_TYP_CD@anadbp01_dwdbp01  --2212
        where pst_nm like '%CA%' or trim(pst_cd) in ('VP026','VP030')
    ) E ON C.COMP_SERIAL_NO = E.COMP_SERIAL_NO 
        AND C.PST_CD = E.PST_CD
;

drop table INCOME_TMP01;
Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FH_TYP as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_037  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_038  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量 --TMU損益
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_039   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_040   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_041
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境外' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_042  --【銀行】境外結構型商品手收 總量*/
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_043   --銀行 FX(WBS) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE, 
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_044  --銀行 FX(TMU) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '開狀' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_045  --【銀行】開狀手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_046  --規劃型信託(股票信託、金錢信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_047  --規劃型信託(員工持股信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_048  --私人銀行事業處業績檔(保管)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '黃金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_049 --銀行 黃金 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FLG,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_051_054 --【證券】複委託-債券手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '基金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_052 --【證券】複委託-基金手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國股票' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_053 --【證券】複委託-外國股票手收 總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '存款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_066 --存款利收總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '放款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_067 --放款利收總量
;

drop table INCOME_TMP01;
Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FH_TYP as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_037  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_038  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量 --TMU損益
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_039   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_040   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_041
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境外' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_042  --【銀行】境外結構型商品手收 總量*/
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_043   --銀行 FX(WBS) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE, 
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_044  --銀行 FX(TMU) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '開狀' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_045  --【銀行】開狀手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_046  --規劃型信託(股票信託、金錢信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_047  --規劃型信託(員工持股信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_048  --私人銀行事業處業績檔(保管)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '黃金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_049 --銀行 黃金 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FLG,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_051_054 --【證券】複委託-債券手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '基金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_052 --【證券】複委託-基金手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國股票' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_053 --【證券】複委託-外國股票手收 總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '存款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_066 --存款利收總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '放款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_067 --放款利收總量
;

drop table INCOME_TMP01;
Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FH_TYP as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_037  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_038  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量 --TMU損益
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_039   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_040   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_041
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境外' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_042  --【銀行】境外結構型商品手收 總量*/
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_043   --銀行 FX(WBS) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE, 
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_044  --銀行 FX(TMU) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '開狀' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_045  --【銀行】開狀手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_046  --規劃型信託(股票信託、金錢信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_047  --規劃型信託(員工持股信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_048  --私人銀行事業處業績檔(保管)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '黃金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_049 --銀行 黃金 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FLG,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_051_054 --【證券】複委託-債券手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '基金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_052 --【證券】複委託-基金手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國股票' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_053 --【證券】複委託-外國股票手收 總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '存款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_066 --存款利收總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '放款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_067 --放款利收總量
;

drop table INCOME_TMP01;
Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FH_TYP as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_037  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_038  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量 --TMU損益
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_039   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_040   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_041
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境外' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_042  --【銀行】境外結構型商品手收 總量*/
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_043   --銀行 FX(WBS) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE, 
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_044  --銀行 FX(TMU) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '開狀' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_045  --【銀行】開狀手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_046  --規劃型信託(股票信託、金錢信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_047  --規劃型信託(員工持股信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_048  --私人銀行事業處業績檔(保管)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '黃金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_049 --銀行 黃金 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FLG,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_051_054 --【證券】複委託-債券手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '基金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_052 --【證券】複委託-基金手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國股票' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_053 --【證券】複委託-外國股票手收 總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '存款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_066 --存款利收總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '放款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_067 --放款利收總量
;

drop table INCOME_TMP01;
Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FH_TYP as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_037  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_038  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量 --TMU損益
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_039   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_040   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_041
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境外' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_042  --【銀行】境外結構型商品手收 總量*/
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_043   --銀行 FX(WBS) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE, 
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_044  --銀行 FX(TMU) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '開狀' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_045  --【銀行】開狀手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_046  --規劃型信託(股票信託、金錢信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_047  --規劃型信託(員工持股信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_048  --私人銀行事業處業績檔(保管)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '黃金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_049 --銀行 黃金 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FLG,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_051_054 --【證券】複委託-債券手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '基金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_052 --【證券】複委託-基金手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國股票' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_053 --【證券】複委託-外國股票手收 總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '存款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_066 --存款利收總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '放款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_067 --放款利收總量
;

drop table INCOME_TMP01;
Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FH_TYP as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_037  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_038  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量 --TMU損益
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_039   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_040   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_041
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境外' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_042  --【銀行】境外結構型商品手收 總量*/
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_043   --銀行 FX(WBS) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE, 
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_044  --銀行 FX(TMU) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '開狀' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_045  --【銀行】開狀手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_046  --規劃型信託(股票信託、金錢信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_047  --規劃型信託(員工持股信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_048  --私人銀行事業處業績檔(保管)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '黃金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_049 --銀行 黃金 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FLG,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_051_054 --【證券】複委託-債券手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '基金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_052 --【證券】複委託-基金手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國股票' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_053 --【證券】複委託-外國股票手收 總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '存款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_066 --存款利收總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '放款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_067 --放款利收總量
;

drop table INCOME_051_054_TMP02;
create table INCOME_051_054_TMP02
as
select 
     idno cust_id,clrdate,
      case 
           when bond  like 'TSSN%'  then   '結構型商品'
            else '債券' end as  FLG,   
      CASE WHEN t.CLRDATE >= l.LAST2_WD 
            THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(t.CLRDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1),'YYYYMM') ||'01'
            ELSE SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6)  ||'01'
       END AS yyyymmdd,
     sum( CFEE * FXRATE)  as amt
 from DSPBM.PB_BONDTRADM_SEC@anadbp01_dwdbp01 t
 LEFT JOIN T_LAST_TWO_WORKDAYS l ON SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6) = l.YM 
 where yyyymmdd = (select max(yyyymmdd) from DSPBM.PB_BONDTRADM_SEC@anadbp01_dwdbp01)
 group by idno,
       case 
           when bond  like 'TSSN%'  then   '結構型商品'
            else '債券' end,clrdate, 
        CASE WHEN t.CLRDATE >= l.LAST2_WD 
            THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(t.CLRDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1),'YYYYMM') ||'01'
            ELSE SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6)  ||'01'
       END;

create table INCOME_066_TMP02
as
     SELECT cust_id,yyyymmdd,sum(AMT) AMT
     FROM (
        SELECT cust_id,yyyymm || '01'  yyyymmdd, sum(GROSS_INCM)  AMT --TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) PRFT_CNTR_CD, ACT_CD, BAL_AMT, GROSS_INCM 利息 
        FROM DSDEP.DEP_NT_ACCT_HS@anadbp01_dwdbp01
        where TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) IN ('2E3000', '2E3200', '2E3300', '2E3400') AND YYYYMM>'202505' 
        group by cust_id,yyyymm
        UNION ALL
        SELECT cust_id, yyyymm || '01' yyyymmdd,sum(GROSS_INCM)  AMT --* --TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) PRFT_CNTR_CD, ACT_CD, AVAIL_BAL, GROSS_INCM 
        FROM DSDEP.DEP_FN_ACCT_HS@anadbp01_dwdbp01
        WHERE  TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) IN ('2E3000', '2E3200', '2E3300', '2E3400') AND YYYYMM>'202505'
        group by cust_id,yyyymm
        UNION ALL
        SELECT  cust_id, yyyymm || '01' yyyymmdd,sum(GROSS_INCM)  AMT-- TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) PRFT_CNTR_CD, ACT_CD, BAL_AMT, GROSS_INCM 
        FROM DSDEP.EMP_DEP_NT_ACCT_HS@anadbp01_dwdbp01
        WHERE  TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) IN ('2E3000', '2E3200', '2E3300', '2E3400') AND YYYYMM>'202505'
        group by cust_id,yyyymm
        ) 
GROUP BY cust_id,yyyymmdd;

create table INCOME_066_TMP02
as
     SELECT cust_id,yyyymmdd,sum(AMT) AMT
     FROM (
        SELECT cust_id,yyyymm || '01'  yyyymmdd, sum(GROSS_INCM)  AMT --TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) PRFT_CNTR_CD, ACT_CD, BAL_AMT, GROSS_INCM 利息 
        FROM DSDEP.DEP_NT_ACCT_HS@anadbp01_dwdbp01
        where TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) IN ('2E3000', '2E3200', '2E3300', '2E3400') AND YYYYMM>'202505' 
        group by cust_id,yyyymm
        UNION ALL
        SELECT cust_id, yyyymm || '01' yyyymmdd,sum(GROSS_INCM)  AMT --* --TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) PRFT_CNTR_CD, ACT_CD, AVAIL_BAL, GROSS_INCM 
        FROM DSDEP.DEP_FN_ACCT_HS@anadbp01_dwdbp01
        WHERE  TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) IN ('2E3000', '2E3200', '2E3300', '2E3400') AND YYYYMM>'202505'
        group by cust_id,yyyymm
        UNION ALL
        SELECT  cust_id, yyyymm || '01' yyyymmdd,sum(GROSS_INCM)  AMT-- TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) PRFT_CNTR_CD, ACT_CD, BAL_AMT, GROSS_INCM 
        FROM DSDEP.EMP_DEP_NT_ACCT_HS@anadbp01_dwdbp01
        WHERE  TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) IN ('2E3000', '2E3200', '2E3300', '2E3400') AND YYYYMM>'202505'
        group by cust_id,yyyymm
        ) 
GROUP BY cust_id,yyyymmdd;

properties.sql:
create table INCOME_067_TMP02
as
select cust_id,yyyymmdd,sum(AMT) AMT
from 
(
    SELECT cust_id, yyyymm ||'01'  as yyyymmdd,sum(GROSS_INCM) AMT  -- ACC_CD, SUM(LN_BAL), SUM(GROSS_INCM) FROM (
    FROM DSLON.LN_NT_ACCT_HS@anadbp01_dwdbp01 A
    WHERE  PRFT_CNTR_CD IN ('2E3000', '2E3200', '2E3300', '2E3400')
    AND  YYYYMM>'202505'
    group by cust_id,yyyymm
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cust_id, yyyymm || '01' as yyyymmdd, sum(INT_INCM - CB_INT_AMT) AMT --ACC_CD, BAL_AMT, 
    FROM DSLON.LN_FN_ACCT_HS@anadbp01_dwdbp01 A
    WHERE TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) IN ('2E3000', '2E3200', '2E3300', '2E3400')
    AND YYYYMM>'202505'
    group by cust_id,yyyymm
)  a 
GROUP BY cust_id,yyyymmdd;

[{"sourceFile":"sources/sql/2._AUM_SUMY.sql","lineStart":7,"lineEnd":140,"sql":"drop table AUM;
create table AUM
as
select    
    TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    DETAIL as PROD,
    TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    LST_MTN_DT AS YYYYMMDD,
    存款AUM AMT
from AUM_005_007_008_009  --存款AUM 總量、台幣存款AUM總量、結構型
where DETAIL is not null
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012  --【銀行】保險_原始投資金額
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    trustprd PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    CurrentTWDValue as AMT
from AUM_013_015_015_016_017_018
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '海外債券(自營)' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
from  AUM_019 --19.銀行_外國債券(自營平台)_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_020 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量

select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_021 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量--【銀行】股票及金錢信託_市值
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '信託保管' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_022  --銀行_信託保管_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    nm  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_023_024--證券_複委託債券_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '基金'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_025  ----25.證券_基金_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '外國股票'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,

from AUM_026  --26.證券_外國股票_AUM總量

;"}]

create table AUM_TMP01
as
select    
    TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    DETAIL as PROD,
    TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    LST_MTN_DT AS YYYYMMDD,
    存款AUM AMT
from AUM_005_007_008_009  --存款AUM 總量、台幣存款AUM總量、結構型
where DETAIL is not null
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012  --【銀行】保險_原始投資金額
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    trustprd PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    CurrentTWDValue as AMT
from AUM_013_015_015_016_017_018
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '海外債券(自營)' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,

    amt 
from  AUM_019 --19.銀行_外國債券(自營平台)_AUM總量

select

    '銀行'  COMP,

    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_020 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_021 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量--【銀行】股票及金錢信託_市值
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '信託保管' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_022  --銀行_信託保管_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    nm  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_023_024--證券_複委託債券_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '基金'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_025  ----25.證券_基金_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '外國股票'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_026  --26.證券_外國股票_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_027   --27.證券_台股_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_028   ----28.股票設質
;

create table INCOME_053_TMP02
as
select 'PM' AP ,idno as cust_id,
        CASE WHEN t.CLRDATE >= l.LAST2_WD 
            THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(t.CLRDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1),'YYYYMM') ||'01'
            ELSE SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6)  ||'01'
       END as yyyymmdd,
       sum((CFEE-ABFEE)*FXRATE) as amt
from DSPBM.PB_STOCKTRADM_PM_SEC@anadbp01_dwdbp01 t
LEFT JOIN T_LAST_TWO_WORKDAYS l ON SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6) = l.YM
where yyyymmdd = (select max(yyyymmdd) from DSPBM.PB_STOCKTRADM_PM_SEC@anadbp01_dwdbp01)
group by idno,CASE WHEN t.CLRDATE >= l.LAST2_WD 
            THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(t.CLRDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1),'YYYYMM') ||'01'
            ELSE SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6)  ||'01'
       END
union
select  'AM' AP ,idno as cust_id,
        CASE WHEN t.CLRDATE >= l.LAST2_WD 
            THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(t.CLRDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1),'YYYYMM') ||'01'
            ELSE SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6)  ||'01'
         END as yyyymmdd,
        sum((CFEE-ABFEE)*FXRATE) as amt
from DSPBM.PB_STOCKTRADM_AM_SEC_M@anadbp01_dwdbp01 t
LEFT JOIN T_LAST_TWO_WORKDAYS l ON SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6) = l.YM
where yyyymmdd =(select max(yyyymmdd) from DSPBM.PB_STOCKTRADM_AM_SEC@anadbp01_dwdbp01)
group by idno,CASE WHEN t.CLRDATE >= l.LAST2_WD 
            THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(t.CLRDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1),'YYYYMM') ||'01'
            ELSE SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6)  ||'01'

create table AUM_023_024_TMP1
as 
select  idno as cust_id,clrdate as yyyymmdd,nm,sum(NETQTY/100 *CPRICE * exch_rt) AMT
from 
(
 select a.*,b.*,
         case when  bond like 'TSSN%' then '複委託結構型商品'
       else '複委託債券' end as NM
from  DSPBM.PB_BONDPOS_SEC@anadbp01_dwdbp01 a 
left join  dsdep.fn_exch_rt@anadbp01_dwdbp01  b 
on a.clrdate=b.prcs_dt and  a.currency=b.curr_cd
) a 
group by idno,clrdate,nm;

drop table INCOME_TMP01;
Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FH_TYP as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_037  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_038  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量 --TMU損益
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_039   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_040   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_041
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境外' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_042  --【銀行】境外結構型商品手收 總量*/
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_043   --銀行 FX(WBS) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE, 
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_044  --銀行 FX(TMU) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '開狀' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_045  --【銀行】開狀手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_046  --規劃型信託(股票信託、金錢信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_047  --規劃型信託(員工持股信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_048  --私人銀行事業處業績檔(保管)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '黃金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_049 --銀行 黃金 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FLG,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_051_054 --【證券】複委託-債券手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '基金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_052 --【證券】複委託-基金手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國股票' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_053 --【證券】複委託-外國股票手收 總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '存款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_066 --存款利收總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '放款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_067 --放款利收總量
;

drop table INCOME_TMP01;
Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE,

      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,

select

from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null

select

      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,

      yyyymmdd,

from INCOME_037  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量

select

      yyyymmdd,

select

      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,

from INCOME_039   --境內結構型商品手收

select

      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_040   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_041

select

      '結構型_境外' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_042  --【銀行】境外結構型商品手收 總量*/
union

      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,

      '',

      '黃金' as SUB_TYPE,

      yyyymmdd,

      AMT
from INCOME_052 --【證券】複委託-基金手收 總量

      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國股票' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_053 --【證券】複委託-外國股票手收 總量

      '利收'  as  TYP,

      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_066 --存款利收總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '放款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_067 --放款利收總量
;

drop table INCOME_052_TMP01;
create table INCOME_052_TMP01
as
select wka28 as cust_id,
        CASE WHEN t.wka02 >= l.LAST2_WD 
            THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(t.wka02,'YYYYMMDD'),1),'YYYYMM') ||'01'
            ELSE SUBSTR(t.wka02,1,6)  ||'01'
       END as yyyymmdd,
       sum(wka31) as amt
from DSPBM.PB_FUNDTRADM_SEC_M@anadbp01_dwdbp01 t
LEFT JOIN T_LAST_TWO_WORKDAYS l ON SUBSTR(t.wka02,1,6) = l.YM
group by wka28, CASE WHEN t.wka02 >= l.LAST2_WD 
            THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(t.wka02,'YYYYMMDD'),1),'YYYYMM') ||'01'
            ELSE SUBSTR(t.wka02,1,6)  ||'01'
       END  ;

drop table AUM_026_TMP0;
create table AUM_026_TMP0
as 
select   idno as cust_id,b.prcs_dt yyyymmdd,sum(NETQTY * CPRICE* exch_rt) as amt 
from  (select *
      from  DSPBM.PB_STOCKPOS_SEC_M@anadbp01_dwdbp01 a ) a
left join 
     ( select A.*
     from dsdep.fn_exch_rt@anadbp01_dwdbp01 a
     inner join 
     ( 
         select substr(prcs_dt,1,6) yyyyymm,max(prcs_dt) prcs_dt 
         from dsdep.fn_exch_rt@anadbp01_dwdbp01 
         group by substr(prcs_dt,1,6)
     ) b on a.prcs_dt=b.prcs_dt
     )b  on a.currency=b.curr_cd and a.yyyymm=substr(b.prcs_dt,1,6)
group by idno,b.prcs_dt
;

drop table INCOME_TMP01;
Create table INCOME_TMP01

      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT

union

drop table INCOME_052_TMP01;
create table INCOME_052_TMP01
as
select wka28 as cust_id,
        CASE WHEN t.wka02 >= l.LAST2_WD 
            THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(t.wka02,'YYYYMMDD'),1),'YYYYMM') ||'01'
            ELSE SUBSTR(t.wka02,1,6)  ||'01'
       END as yyyymmdd,
       sum(wka31) as amt
from DSPBM.PB_FUNDTRADM_SEC_M@anadbp01_dwdbp01 t
LEFT JOIN T_LAST_TWO_WORKDAYS l ON SUBSTR(t.wka02,1,6) = l.YM
group by wka28, CASE WHEN t.wka02 >= l.LAST2_WD 
            THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(t.wka02,'YYYYMMDD'),1),'YYYYMM') ||'01'
            ELSE SUBSTR(t.wka02,1,6)  ||'01'
       END  ;

[{"sourceFile":"sources/sql/2._AUM_SUMY.~sql","lineStart":177,"lineEnd":217,"sql":"--AUM存款排除私銀法金認列客戶
drop table AUM_BASE;
create table AUM_BASE
as 
select a.* 
from 
    (select *
    from AUM_TMP01 
    where typ='存款'　
    ) a 
left join pb_cust_2AO b
on substr(a.yyyymmdd,1,6)=b.yyyymm　and a.cust_id=b.cust_id
where b.cust_id is null 
union 
select *
from AUM_TMP01 
where typ='投資'
;



drop table AUM_TMP02;
Create table AUM_TMP02
as 
select a.*,
       b.emp_no,
       b.prft_cntr_cd,
       b.sht_nm,
       case 
          when sht_nm like '%業務一部%' then 'TW一部'
          when sht_nm like '%業務二部%' then 'TW二部'
        end as SHT_EASY_NM,
      substr(
          sht_nm,
          instr(sht_nm,'業')+2,
          instr(sht_nm,'部') -instr(sht_nm,'業') -1
          )  as SHT_SUB_NM,
       b.pst_nm
from (select * from AUM_BASE where yyyymmdd>='20231201') a   --69775
inner join PB_CUST_005 b  --69775
on a.cust_id =b.cust_id and substr(a.yyyymmdd,1,6)=b.yyyymm;"}]

create table AUM_TMP01
as
select    
    TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    DETAIL as PROD,
    TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    LST_MTN_DT AS YYYYMMDD,
    存款AUM AMT
from AUM_005_007_008_009  --存款AUM 總量、台幣存款AUM總量、結構型
where DETAIL is not null
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012  --【銀行】保險_原始投資金額
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    trustprd PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    CurrentTWDValue as AMT
from AUM_013_015_015_016_017_018
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '海外債券(自營)' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
from  AUM_019 --19.銀行_外國債券(自營平台)_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_020 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_021 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量--【銀行】股票及金錢信託_市值
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '信託保管' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_022  --銀行_信託保管_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    nm  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_023_024--證券_複委託債券_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '基金'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_025  ----25.證券_基金_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '外國股票'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_026  --26.證券_外國股票_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_027   --27.證券_台股_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_028   ----28.股票設質
;

create table INCOME_053_TMP02
as
select 'PM' AP ,idno as cust_id,
        CASE WHEN t.CLRDATE >= l.LAST2_WD 
            THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(t.CLRDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1),'YYYYMM') ||'01'
            ELSE SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6)  ||'01'
       END as yyyymmdd,
       sum((CFEE-ABFEE)*FXRATE) as amt
from DSPBM.PB_STOCKTRADM_PM_SEC@anadbp01_dwdbp01 t
LEFT JOIN T_LAST_TWO_WORKDAYS l ON SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6) = l.YM
where yyyymmdd = (select max(yyyymmdd) from DSPBM.PB_STOCKTRADM_PM_SEC@anadbp01_dwdbp01)
group by idno,CASE WHEN t.CLRDATE >= l.LAST2_WD 
            THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(t.CLRDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1),'YYYYMM') ||'01'
            ELSE SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6)  ||'01'
       END
union
select  'AM' AP ,idno as cust_id,
        CASE WHEN t.CLRDATE >= l.LAST2_WD 
            THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(t.CLRDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1),'YYYYMM') ||'01'
            ELSE SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6)  ||'01'
         END as yyyymmdd,
        sum((CFEE-ABFEE)*FXRATE) as amt
from DSPBM.PB_STOCKTRADM_AM_SEC_M@anadbp01_dwdbp01 t
LEFT JOIN T_LAST_TWO_WORKDAYS l ON SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6) = l.YM
where yyyymmdd =(select max(yyyymmdd) from DSPBM.PB_STOCKTRADM_AM_SEC@anadbp01_dwdbp01)
group by idno,CASE WHEN t.CLRDATE >= l.LAST2_WD 
            THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(t.CLRDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1),'YYYYMM') ||'01'
            ELSE SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6)  ||'01'
         END;

create table AUM_026_TMP0
as 
select   idno as cust_id,b.prcs_dt yyyymmdd,sum(NETQTY * CPRICE* exch_rt) as amt 
from  (select *
      from  DSPBM.PB_STOCKPOS_SEC_M@anadbp01_dwdbp01 a ) a
left join 
     ( select A.*
     from dsdep.fn_exch_rt@anadbp01_dwdbp01 a
     inner join 
     ( 
         select substr(prcs_dt,1,6) yyyyymm,max(prcs_dt) prcs_dt 
         from dsdep.fn_exch_rt@anadbp01_dwdbp01 
         group by substr(prcs_dt,1,6)
     ) b on a.prcs_dt=b.prcs_dt
     )b  on a.currency=b.curr_cd and a.yyyymm=substr(b.prcs_dt,1,6)
group by idno,b.prcs_dt
;

            ELSE SUBSTR(t.wka02,1,6)  ||'01'
       END;

properties.sql:
drop table INCOME_052_TMP02;
create table INCOME_052_TMP02
as
select  wka28 as cust_id,
        CASE WHEN t.wka02 >= l.LAST2_WD 
            THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(t.wka02,'YYYYMMDD'),1),'YYYYMM') ||'01'
            ELSE SUBSTR(t.wka02,1,6)  ||'01'
       END as yyyymmdd,
       sum(wka31) as amt
from DSPBM.PB_FUNDTRADM_SEC@anadbp01_dwdbp01 t
LEFT JOIN T_LAST_TWO_WORKDAYS l ON SUBSTR(t.wka02,1,6) = l.YM
where yyyymmdd = (select max(yyyymmdd) from DSPBM.PB_BONDTRADM_SEC@anadbp01_dwdbp01)
group by wka28, CASE WHEN t.wka02 >= l.LAST2_WD 
            THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(t.wka02,'YYYYMMDD'),1),'YYYYMM') ||'01'
            ELSE SUBSTR(t.wka02,1,6)  ||'01'
       END;

 (
  select idno, CLRDATE  YYYYMMDD,NETQTY ,CPRICE,currency --

  )b  on a.currency=b.curr_cd and yyyymmdd=prcs_dt

drop table INCOME_052_TMP02;
create table INCOME_052_TMP02
as
select  wka28 as cust_id,
        CASE WHEN t.wka02 >= l.LAST2_WD 
            THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(t.wka02,'YYYYMMDD'),1),'YYYYMM') ||'01'
            ELSE SUBSTR(t.wka02,1,6)  ||'01'
       END as yyyymmdd,
       sum(wka31) as amt
from DSPBM.PB_FUNDTRADM_SEC@anadbp01_dwdbp01 t
LEFT JOIN T_LAST_TWO_WORKDAYS l ON SUBSTR(t.wka02,1,6) = l.YM
where yyyymmdd = (select max(yyyymmdd) from DSPBM.PB_BONDTRADM_SEC@anadbp01_dwdbp01)
group by wka28, CASE WHEN t.wka02 >= l.LAST2_WD 
            THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(t.wka02,'YYYYMMDD'),1),'YYYYMM') ||'01'
            ELSE SUBSTR(t.wka02,1,6)  ||'01'
       END;

create table AUM_026_TMP0
as 
select   idno as cust_id,b.prcs_dt yyyymmdd,sum(NETQTY * CPRICE* exch_rt) as amt 
from  (select *
      from  DSPBM.PB_STOCKPOS_SEC_M@anadbp01_dwdbp01 a ) a
left join 
     ( select A.*
     from dsdep.fn_exch_rt@anadbp01_dwdbp01 a
     inner join 
     ( 
         select substr(prcs_dt,1,6) yyyyymm,max(prcs_dt) prcs_dt 
         from dsdep.fn_exch_rt@anadbp01_dwdbp01 
         group by substr(prcs_dt,1,6)
     ) b on a.prcs_dt=b.prcs_dt
     )b  on a.currency=b.curr_cd and a.yyyymm=substr(b.prcs_dt,1,6)
group by idno,b.prcs_dt
;

drop table INCOME_053_TMP01;
create table INCOME_053_TMP01
as
select 'PM' AP ,idno as cust_id,
        CASE WHEN t.CLRDATE >= l.LAST2_WD 
            THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(t.CLRDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1),'YYYYMM') ||'01'
            ELSE SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6)  ||'01'
       END as yyyymmdd,
       sum((CFEE-ABFEE)*FXRATE) as amt
from DSPBM.PB_STOCKTRADM_PM_SEC_M@anadbp01_dwdbp01 t
LEFT JOIN T_LAST_TWO_WORKDAYS l ON SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6) = l.YM
group by idno,CASE WHEN t.CLRDATE >= l.LAST2_WD 
            THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(t.CLRDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1),'YYYYMM') ||'01'
            ELSE SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6)  ||'01'
       END
union
select  'AM' AP ,idno as cust_id,
         CASE WHEN t.CLRDATE >= l.LAST2_WD 
            THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(t.CLRDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1),'YYYYMM') ||'01'
            ELSE SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6)  ||'01'
         END as yyyymmdd,
        sum((CFEE-ABFEE)*FXRATE) as amt
from DSPBM.PB_STOCKTRADM_AM_SEC_M@anadbp01_dwdbp01 t
LEFT JOIN T_LAST_TWO_WORKDAYS l ON SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6) = l.YM
group by idno,CASE WHEN t.CLRDATE >= l.LAST2_WD 
            THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(t.CLRDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1),'YYYYMM') ||'01'
            ELSE SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6)  ||'01'
       END;

create table AUM_026_TMP1
as 
select  idno as cust_id,yyyymmdd,sum(NETQTY * CPRICE* exch_rt) as amt 
  from 
 (
  select idno, CLRDATE  YYYYMMDD,NETQTY ,CPRICE,currency --
  from DSPBM.PB_STOCKPOS_SEC@anadbp01_dwdbp01
  ) a
  left join 
  (
  select * from dsdep.fn_exch_rt@anadbp01_dwdbp01 --where prcs_dt='20240401'
  )b  on a.currency=b.curr_cd and yyyymmdd=prcs_dt
  group by idno,yyyymmdd;

drop table INCOME_053_TMP02;
create table INCOME_053_TMP02
as
select 'PM' AP ,idno as cust_id,
        CASE WHEN t.CLRDATE >= l.LAST2_WD 
            THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(t.CLRDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1),'YYYYMM') ||'01'
            ELSE SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6)  ||'01'
       END as yyyymmdd,
       sum((CFEE-ABFEE)*FXRATE) as amt
from DSPBM.PB_STOCKTRADM_PM_SEC@anadbp01_dwdbp01 t
LEFT JOIN T_LAST_TWO_WORKDAYS l ON SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6) = l.YM
where yyyymmdd = (select max(yyyymmdd) from DSPBM.PB_STOCKTRADM_PM_SEC@anadbp01_dwdbp01)
group by idno,CASE WHEN t.CLRDATE >= l.LAST2_WD 
            THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(t.CLRDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1),'YYYYMM') ||'01'
            ELSE SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6)  ||'01'
       END
union
select  'AM' AP ,idno as cust_id,
        CASE WHEN t.CLRDATE >= l.LAST2_WD 
            THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(t.CLRDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1),'YYYYMM') ||'01'
            ELSE SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6)  ||'01'
         END as yyyymmdd,
        sum((CFEE-ABFEE)*FXRATE) as amt
from DSPBM.PB_STOCKTRADM_AM_SEC_M@anadbp01_dwdbp01 t
LEFT JOIN T_LAST_TWO_WORKDAYS l ON SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6) = l.YM
where yyyymmdd =(select max(yyyymmdd) from DSPBM.PB_STOCKTRADM_AM_SEC@anadbp01_dwdbp01)
group by idno,CASE WHEN t.CLRDATE >= l.LAST2_WD 
            THEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(t.CLRDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1),'YYYYMM') ||'01'
            ELSE SUBSTR(t.CLRDATE,1,6)  ||'01'
         END;

drop table AUM_BASE;
create table AUM_BASE
as 
select a.* 
from 
    (select *
    from AUM_TMP01 
    where typ='存款'　
    ) a 
left join pb_cust_2AO b
on substr(a.yyyymmdd,1,6)=b.yyyymm　and a.cust_id=b.cust_id
where b.cust_id is null 
union 
select *
from AUM_TMP01 
where typ='投資'
;
