drop table INCOME_TMP02;
Create table INCOME_TMP02
as 
select a.*,
       b.emp_no,
       b.prft_cntr_cd,
       b.sht_nm,
       case 
          when sht_nm like '%業務一部%' then 'TW一部'
          when sht_nm like '%業務二部%' then 'TW二部'
        end as SHT_EASY_NM,
      substr(
          sht_nm,
          instr(sht_nm,'業')+2,
          instr(sht_nm,'部') -instr(sht_nm,'業') -1
          )  as SHT_SUB_NM, 
       b.pst_nm
--count(*)
from INCOME_TMP01 a   --55772
left join PB_CUST_005 b  --55772
on a.cust_id =b.cust_id and substr(a.yyyymmdd,1,6)=b.yyyymm;

[{"sourceFile":"sources/sql/8.INCOME_DETAIL.sql","lineStart":64,"lineEnd":88,"sql":"drop table INCOME_033_034_035_036;
create table INCOME_033_034_035_036
as 
select  to_char(to_date(feedate+19110000,'yyyymmdd') ,'yyyymmdd' ) as yyyymmdd --substr(FEEDATE,1,6)  -- FHID,IDNO as cust_id,      
        ,idno as cust_id       
        ,case 
              when FHID not in ('PS','CB','YB','SN') then '基金' 
              when TRIM(FHID) ='YB' then 'ETF'
              when FHID ='PS' then '海外股票'
              when FHID like 'TA%' or FHID  like 'TB%' or FHID  like 'TD%' or FHID  like 'TE%'  then '集合管理帳戶'
        end as   FH_TYP 
        ,baopcccode PCCODE
        ,sum(BrhRebateAmt) as AMT
from DSFND.PB_FUND_SPREAD_DAILY@anadbp01_dwdbp01 
where  (baopcccode like '2E%' or saopcccode like '2E%') and feedate>='011212'  --and feedate='011403' 
group by  
      to_char(to_date(feedate+19110000,'yyyymmdd') ,'yyyymmdd' )   --substr(FEEDATE,1,6),
      ,idno
      ,case 
              when FHID not in ('PS','CB','YB','SN') then '基金' 
              when TRIM(FHID) ='YB' then 'ETF'
              when FHID ='PS' then '海外股票'
              when FHID like 'TA%' or FHID  like 'TB%' or FHID  like 'TD%' or FHID  like 'TE%'  then '集合管理帳戶'
       end
       ,baopcccode;"}]

drop table AUM_TMP01;
create table AUM_TMP01
as
select    
    TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    DETAIL as PROD,
    TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    LST_MTN_DT AS YYYYMMDD,
    存款AUM AMT
from AUM_005_007_008_009  --存款AUM 總量、台幣存款AUM總量、結構型
where DETAIL is not null
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012  --【銀行】保險_原始投資金額
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    trustprd PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    CurrentTWDValue as AMT
from AUM_013_015_015_016_017_018
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '海外債券(自營)' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
from  AUM_019 --19.銀行_外國債券(自營平台)_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_020 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_021 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量--【銀行】股票及金錢信託_市值
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '信託保管' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt

union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    nm  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_023_024--證券_複委託債券_AUM總量

select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '基金'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_025  ----25.證券_基金_AUM總量

select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '外國股票'  as PROD,

    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_026  --26.證券_外國股票_AUM總量

    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,

    yyyymmdd,

    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,

    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_028   ----28.股票設質

drop table INCOME_TMP01;
Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,

      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量

drop table INCOME_TMP02;
Create table INCOME_TMP02
as 
select a.*,
       b.emp_no,
       b.prft_cntr_cd,
       b.sht_nm,
       case 
          when sht_nm like '%業務一部%' then 'TW一部'
          when sht_nm like '%業務二部%' then 'TW二部'
        end as SHT_EASY_NM,
      substr(
          sht_nm,
          instr(sht_nm,'業')+2,
          instr(sht_nm,'部') -instr(sht_nm,'業') -1
          )  as SHT_SUB_NM, 
       b.pst_nm
--count(*)
from INCOME_TMP01 a   --55772
left join PB_CUST_005 b  --55772
on a.cust_id =b.cust_id and substr(a.yyyymmdd,1,6)=b.yyyymm;

[{"sourceFile":"sources/sql/8.INCOME_DETAIL.sql","lineStart":64,"lineEnd":88,"sql":"drop table INCOME_033_034_035_036;
create table INCOME_033_034_035_036
as 
select  to_char(to_date(feedate+19110000,'yyyymmdd') ,'yyyymmdd' ) as yyyymmdd --substr(FEEDATE,1,6)  -- FHID,IDNO as cust_id,      
        ,idno as cust_id       
        ,case 
              when FHID not in ('PS','CB','YB','SN') then '基金' 
              when TRIM(FHID) ='YB' then 'ETF'
              when FHID ='PS' then '海外股票'
              when FHID like 'TA%' or FHID  like 'TB%' or FHID  like 'TD%' or FHID  like 'TE%'  then '集合管理帳戶'
        end as   FH_TYP 
        ,baopcccode PCCODE
        ,sum(BrhRebateAmt) as AMT
from DSFND.PB_FUND_SPREAD_DAILY@anadbp01_dwdbp01 
where  (baopcccode like '2E%' or saopcccode like '2E%') and feedate>='011212'  --and feedate='011403' 
group by  
      to_char(to_date(feedate+19110000,'yyyymmdd') ,'yyyymmdd' )   --substr(FEEDATE,1,6),
      ,idno
      ,case 
              when FHID not in ('PS','CB','YB','SN') then '基金' 
              when TRIM(FHID) ='YB' then 'ETF'
              when FHID ='PS' then '海外股票'
              when FHID like 'TA%' or FHID  like 'TB%' or FHID  like 'TD%' or FHID  like 'TE%'  then '集合管理帳戶'
       end
       ,baopcccode;"}]

Create table INCOME_TMP02
as 
select a.*,
       b.emp_no,
       b.prft_cntr_cd,
       b.sht_nm,
       case 
          when sht_nm like '%業務一部%' then 'TW一部'
          when sht_nm like '%業務二部%' then 'TW二部'
        end as SHT_EASY_NM,
      substr(
          sht_nm,
          instr(sht_nm,'業')+2,
          instr(sht_nm,'部') -instr(sht_nm,'業') -1
          )  as SHT_SUB_NM, 
       b.pst_nm
--count(*)
from INCOME_TMP01 a   --55772
left join PB_CUST_005 b  --55772
on a.cust_id =b.cust_id and substr(a.yyyymmdd,1,6)=b.yyyymm;

drop table INCOME_TMP01;
Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FH_TYP as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_037  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_038  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量 --TMU損益
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_039   --境內結構型商品手收 
union

drop table AUM_TMP01;
create table AUM_TMP01
as
select    
    TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    DETAIL as PROD,
    TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    LST_MTN_DT AS YYYYMMDD,
    存款AUM AMT
from AUM_005_007_008_009  --存款AUM 總量、台幣存款AUM總量、結構型
where DETAIL is not null
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012  --【銀行】保險_原始投資金額
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    trustprd PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    CurrentTWDValue as AMT
from AUM_013_015_015_016_017_018
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '海外債券(自營)' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
from  AUM_019 --19.銀行_外國債券(自營平台)_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,

    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_020 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量

select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,

    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_021 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量--【銀行】股票及金錢信託_市值
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,

    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt

select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    nm  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_023_024--證券_複委託債券_AUM總量

select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '基金'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT

    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '外國股票'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_026  --26.證券_外國股票_AUM總量

create table PB_CUST_2AO
as

from dscif.ao_cust_rel_hs@anadbp01_dwdbp01

group by yyyymm,cust_id
having count(*)>1

having count(*)>1

drop table INCOME_TMP01;
Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FH_TYP as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_037  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_038  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量 --TMU損益
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_039   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_040   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_041
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境外' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_042  --【銀行】境外結構型商品手收 總量*/
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_043   --銀行 FX(WBS) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE, 
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_044  --銀行 FX(TMU) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '開狀' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_045  --【銀行】開狀手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_046  --規劃型信託(股票信託、金錢信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_047  --規劃型信託(員工持股信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_048  --私人銀行事業處業績檔(保管)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '黃金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_049 --銀行 黃金 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FLG,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_051_054 --【證券】複委託-債券手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '基金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_052 --【證券】複委託-基金手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國股票' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_053 --【證券】複委託-外國股票手收 總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '存款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_066 --存款利收總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '放款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_067 --放款利收總量
;

drop table INCOME_TMP01;
Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FH_TYP as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_037  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_038  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量 --TMU損益
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_039   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_040   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_041
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境外' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_042  --【銀行】境外結構型商品手收 總量*/
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_043   --銀行 FX(WBS) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE, 
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_044  --銀行 FX(TMU) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '開狀' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_045  --【銀行】開狀手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_046  --規劃型信託(股票信託、金錢信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_047  --規劃型信託(員工持股信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_048  --私人銀行事業處業績檔(保管)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '黃金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_049 --銀行 黃金 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FLG,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_051_054 --【證券】複委託-債券手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '基金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_052 --【證券】複委託-基金手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國股票' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_053 --【證券】複委託-外國股票手收 總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '存款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_066 --存款利收總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '放款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_067 --放款利收總量
;

select 
    '投資'  TYP,

FROM aum_012
union 
select

select

from AUM_028   ----28.股票設質
;

drop table INCOME_TMP01;
Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FH_TYP as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,

drop table INCOME_TMP01;
Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FH_TYP as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_037  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_038  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量 --TMU損益
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_039   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_040   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_041
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境外' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_042  --【銀行】境外結構型商品手收 總量*/
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_043   --銀行 FX(WBS) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE, 
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_044  --銀行 FX(TMU) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '開狀' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_045  --【銀行】開狀手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_046  --規劃型信託(股票信託、金錢信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_047  --規劃型信託(員工持股信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_048  --私人銀行事業處業績檔(保管)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '黃金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_049 --銀行 黃金 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FLG,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_051_054 --【證券】複委託-債券手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '基金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_052 --【證券】複委託-基金手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國股票' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_053 --【證券】複委託-外國股票手收 總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '存款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_066 --存款利收總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '放款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_067 --放款利收總量
;

drop table AUM_TMP01;
create table AUM_TMP01
as
select    
    TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    DETAIL as PROD,
    TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    LST_MTN_DT AS YYYYMMDD,
    存款AUM AMT
from AUM_005_007_008_009  --存款AUM 總量、台幣存款AUM總量、結構型
where DETAIL is not null
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012  --【銀行】保險_原始投資金額
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    trustprd PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    CurrentTWDValue as AMT
from AUM_013_015_015_016_017_018
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '海外債券(自營)' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
from  AUM_019 --19.銀行_外國債券(自營平台)_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_020 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_021 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量--【銀行】股票及金錢信託_市值
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '信託保管' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_022  --銀行_信託保管_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    nm  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_023_024--證券_複委託債券_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '基金'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_025  ----25.證券_基金_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '外國股票'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_026  --26.證券_外國股票_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_027   --27.證券_台股_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_028   ----28.股票設質
;

drop table INCOME_TMP01;
Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FH_TYP as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_037  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_038  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量 --TMU損益
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_039   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_040   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_041
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境外' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_042  --【銀行】境外結構型商品手收 總量*/
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_043   --銀行 FX(WBS) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE, 
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_044  --銀行 FX(TMU) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '開狀' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_045  --【銀行】開狀手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_046  --規劃型信託(股票信託、金錢信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_047  --規劃型信託(員工持股信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_048  --私人銀行事業處業績檔(保管)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '黃金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_049 --銀行 黃金 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FLG,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_051_054 --【證券】複委託-債券手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '基金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_052 --【證券】複委託-基金手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國股票' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_053 --【證券】複委託-外國股票手收 總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '存款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_066 --存款利收總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '放款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_067 --放款利收總量
;

drop table INCOME_TMP01;
Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,

      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null

select

drop table AUM_TMP01;
create table AUM_TMP01
as
select    
    TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    DETAIL as PROD,
    TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    LST_MTN_DT AS YYYYMMDD,
    存款AUM AMT
from AUM_005_007_008_009  --存款AUM 總量、台幣存款AUM總量、結構型
where DETAIL is not null
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012  --【銀行】保險_原始投資金額
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    trustprd PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    CurrentTWDValue as AMT
from AUM_013_015_015_016_017_018
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '海外債券(自營)' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
from  AUM_019 --19.銀行_外國債券(自營平台)_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_020 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_021 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量--【銀行】股票及金錢信託_市值
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '信託保管' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_022  --銀行_信託保管_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    nm  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_023_024--證券_複委託債券_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '基金'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_025  ----25.證券_基金_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '外國股票'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_026  --26.證券_外國股票_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_027   --27.證券_台股_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_028   ----28.股票設質
;

properties.sql:
drop table INCOME_TMP01;
Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FH_TYP as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_037  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_038  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量 --TMU損益
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_039   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_040   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_041
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境外' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_042  --【銀行】境外結構型商品手收 總量*/
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_043   --銀行 FX(WBS) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE, 
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_044  --銀行 FX(TMU) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '開狀' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_045  --【銀行】開狀手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_046  --規劃型信託(股票信託、金錢信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_047  --規劃型信託(員工持股信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_048  --私人銀行事業處業績檔(保管)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '黃金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_049 --銀行 黃金 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FLG,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_051_054 --【證券】複委託-債券手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '基金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_052 --【證券】複委託-基金手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國股票' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_053 --【證券】複委託-外國股票手收 總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '存款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_066 --存款利收總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '放款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_067 --放款利收總量
;

properties.sql:
drop table INCOME_TMP01;
Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FH_TYP as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_037  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_038  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量 --TMU損益
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_039   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_040   --境內結構型商品手收 
union

drop table AUM_TMP01;
create table AUM_TMP01
as
select    
    TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    DETAIL as PROD,
    TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    LST_MTN_DT AS YYYYMMDD,
    存款AUM AMT
from AUM_005_007_008_009  --存款AUM 總量、台幣存款AUM總量、結構型
where DETAIL is not null
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012  --【銀行】保險_原始投資金額
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    trustprd PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    CurrentTWDValue as AMT
from AUM_013_015_015_016_017_018
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '海外債券(自營)' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
from  AUM_019 --19.銀行_外國債券(自營平台)_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_020 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_021 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量--【銀行】股票及金錢信託_市值
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '信託保管' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_022  --銀行_信託保管_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    nm  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_023_024--證券_複委託債券_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '基金'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_025  ----25.證券_基金_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '外國股票'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_026  --26.證券_外國股票_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_027   --27.證券_台股_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_028   ----28.股票設質
;

properties.sql:
drop table INCOME_TMP01;
Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FH_TYP as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_037  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_038  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量 --TMU損益
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_039   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_040   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_041
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境外' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_042  --【銀行】境外結構型商品手收 總量*/
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_043   --銀行 FX(WBS) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE, 
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_044  --銀行 FX(TMU) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '開狀' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_045  --【銀行】開狀手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_046  --規劃型信託(股票信託、金錢信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_047  --規劃型信託(員工持股信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_048  --私人銀行事業處業績檔(保管)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '黃金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_049 --銀行 黃金 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FLG,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_051_054 --【證券】複委託-債券手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '基金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_052 --【證券】複委託-基金手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國股票' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_053 --【證券】複委託-外國股票手收 總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '存款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_066 --存款利收總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '放款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_067 --放款利收總量
;

drop table INCOME_TMP01;

      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險

select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量

select

      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,

      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量

select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FH_TYP as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,

      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_037  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_038  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量 --TMU損益

select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,

      PCCODE,

drop table AUM_TMP01;
create table AUM_TMP01
as
select    
    TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    DETAIL as PROD,
    TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    LST_MTN_DT AS YYYYMMDD,
    存款AUM AMT
from AUM_005_007_008_009  --存款AUM 總量、台幣存款AUM總量、結構型
where DETAIL is not null
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012  --【銀行】保險_原始投資金額
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    trustprd PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    CurrentTWDValue as AMT
from AUM_013_015_015_016_017_018
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '海外債券(自營)' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
from  AUM_019 --19.銀行_外國債券(自營平台)_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_020 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_021 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量--【銀行】股票及金錢信託_市值
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '信託保管' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_022  --銀行_信託保管_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    nm  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_023_024--證券_複委託債券_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '基金'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_025  ----25.證券_基金_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '外國股票'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_026  --26.證券_外國股票_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_027   --27.證券_台股_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_028   ----28.股票設質
;

properties.sql:
drop table INCOME_TMP01;
Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FH_TYP as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_037  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_038  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量 --TMU損益
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_039   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_040   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_041
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境外' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_042  --【銀行】境外結構型商品手收 總量*/
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_043   --銀行 FX(WBS) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE, 
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_044  --銀行 FX(TMU) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '開狀' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_045  --【銀行】開狀手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_046  --規劃型信託(股票信託、金錢信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_047  --規劃型信託(員工持股信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_048  --私人銀行事業處業績檔(保管)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '黃金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_049 --銀行 黃金 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FLG,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_051_054 --【證券】複委託-債券手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '基金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_052 --【證券】複委託-基金手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國股票' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_053 --【證券】複委託-外國股票手收 總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '存款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_066 --存款利收總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '放款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_067 --放款利收總量
;

drop table INCOME_TMP01;
Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FH_TYP as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_037  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量

drop table AUM_TMP01;
create table AUM_TMP01
as
select    
    TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    DETAIL as PROD,
    TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    LST_MTN_DT AS YYYYMMDD,
    存款AUM AMT
from AUM_005_007_008_009  --存款AUM 總量、台幣存款AUM總量、結構型
where DETAIL is not null
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012  --【銀行】保險_原始投資金額
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    trustprd PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    CurrentTWDValue as AMT
from AUM_013_015_015_016_017_018
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '海外債券(自營)' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
from  AUM_019 --19.銀行_外國債券(自營平台)_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_020 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_021 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量--【銀行】股票及金錢信託_市值
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '信託保管' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_022  --銀行_信託保管_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    nm  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_023_024--證券_複委託債券_AUM總量

select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '基金'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT

    '證券'  COMP,
    '外國股票'  as PROD,

    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_026  --26.證券_外國股票_AUM總量

select

from AUM_028   ----28.股票設質
;

drop table INCOME_TMP01;
Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FH_TYP as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_037  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_038  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量 --TMU損益
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_039   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_040   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_041
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境外' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_042  --【銀行】境外結構型商品手收 總量*/
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_043   --銀行 FX(WBS) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE, 
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_044  --銀行 FX(TMU) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '開狀' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_045  --【銀行】開狀手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_046  --規劃型信託(股票信託、金錢信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_047  --規劃型信託(員工持股信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_048  --私人銀行事業處業績檔(保管)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '黃金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_049 --銀行 黃金 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FLG,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_051_054 --【證券】複委託-債券手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '基金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_052 --【證券】複委託-基金手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國股票' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_053 --【證券】複委託-外國股票手收 總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '存款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_066 --存款利收總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '放款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_067 --放款利收總量
;

drop table INCOME_TMP01;
Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,

properties.sql:
drop table INCOME_TMP01;
Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FH_TYP as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_037  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_038  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量 --TMU損益
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_039   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_040   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_041
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境外' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_042  --【銀行】境外結構型商品手收 總量*/
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_043   --銀行 FX(WBS) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE, 
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_044  --銀行 FX(TMU) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '開狀' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_045  --【銀行】開狀手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_046  --規劃型信託(股票信託、金錢信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_047  --規劃型信託(員工持股信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_048  --私人銀行事業處業績檔(保管)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '黃金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_049 --銀行 黃金 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FLG,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_051_054 --【證券】複委託-債券手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '基金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_052 --【證券】複委託-基金手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國股票' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_053 --【證券】複委託-外國股票手收 總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '存款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_066 --存款利收總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '放款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_067 --放款利收總量
;

properties.sql:
drop table INCOME_TMP01;
Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FH_TYP as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_037  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_038  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量 --TMU損益
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_039   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_040   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_041
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境外' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_042  --【銀行】境外結構型商品手收 總量*/
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_043   --銀行 FX(WBS) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE, 
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_044  --銀行 FX(TMU) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '開狀' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_045  --【銀行】開狀手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_046  --規劃型信託(股票信託、金錢信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_047  --規劃型信託(員工持股信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_048  --私人銀行事業處業績檔(保管)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '黃金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_049 --銀行 黃金 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FLG,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_051_054 --【證券】複委託-債券手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '基金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_052 --【證券】複委託-基金手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國股票' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_053 --【證券】複委託-外國股票手收 總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '存款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_066 --存款利收總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '放款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_067 --放款利收總量
;

properties.sql:
drop table INCOME_TMP01;
Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FH_TYP as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_037  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_038  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量 --TMU損益
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_039   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_040   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_041
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境外' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_042  --【銀行】境外結構型商品手收 總量*/
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_043   --銀行 FX(WBS) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE, 
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_044  --銀行 FX(TMU) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '開狀' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_045  --【銀行】開狀手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_046  --規劃型信託(股票信託、金錢信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_047  --規劃型信託(員工持股信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_048  --私人銀行事業處業績檔(保管)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '黃金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_049 --銀行 黃金 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FLG,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_051_054 --【證券】複委託-債券手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '基金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_052 --【證券】複委託-基金手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國股票' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_053 --【證券】複委託-外國股票手收 總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '存款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_066 --存款利收總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '放款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_067 --放款利收總量
;
